pr_body:
There is a DLS query referencing a runtime field loaded from _source, when we create the collector manager we retrieve the numDocs which triggers going through all segments and executing the script for each document. StoredFieldSourceProvider relies on leaf ordinals to build an array, but those ordinals are not populated when computing the numDocs via BaseCompositeReader, as that goes through the subreaders contexts, and not the context leaves (there is a subtle difference that bites us there).

Fixes #111637
pr_comment: Hi @original-brownbear, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

This should be backported to 8.15 as well, it's a pretty nasty bug, although hopefully in practice there are not many users relying on runtime fields loaded from _source in their DLS queries, as that will badly affect performance of each and every query due to having to load stored fields for every document.

I think I found another place where we potentially have the same issue: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/search/lookup/SyntheticSourceProvider.java#L25 . You should be able to repro that with your same test, but using synthetic source. I guess we should fix that too as a follow-up?

review_comment: interesting, I did not even know this one existed, I would have used LeafReaderContext itself as a key, I've seen that done in other places too. But this should be fine as well
